usage: The word '褲' refers to garments worn on the lower body, covering from the waist down to various lengths.
It is commonly used to specify types of pants or trousers in Cantonese.
You can combine it with words denoting style, material, or purpose, such as 牛仔褲 (jeans) or 運動褲 (sports trousers).
'褲' as a noun can be singular or plural depending on context, often no extra marker is needed for plural in Cantonese.
In questions and statements, '褲' fits naturally after classifiers or numbers, like 一條褲 (one pair of trousers).
